_doc: Gacha (design/gacha.md), paid with gems (Đá) only. cost_per_pull gems a pull (10 pulls = 10x). rates = the published chance of each rarity per pull. pity: the pity_at-th pull since the last legendary on a banner is a legendary (each banner counts its own). A banner gives items of its slots that the slot's class can wear (shared or its own class); a rarity with no such item falls back to the next lower one. A duplicate (an item already owned) becomes dup_gold of its rarity instead. history_keep = pulls kept per banner in Lịch sử quay. Numbers open for the user to tune (master.md). dup_shards: Mảnh thẻ a duplicate pull gives on top of its gold (design/skill-tree-v2.md).
